groups.defect: EventManager.create dereferences mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration without optional chaining, throwing TypeError for Google Meet bookings when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: All five describe the same missing optional chaining at EventManager.ts lines 118-119, with the same one-line fix.

groups.defect: Google updateEvent and deleteEvent fallback uses find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId) inside the branch where externalCalendarId is falsy, so it never matches; update gets an undefined calendarId and delete falls back to 'primary' and misses the real event.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same self-defeating fallback, either in updateEvent, in deleteEvent or in both. The same expression is copy-pasted in two functions, so each needs its own edit.

groups.defect: evt.destinationCalendar falls back to null, so evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars) silently does nothing and COLLECTIVE hosts' calendars are dropped.
groups.rationale: Both report the same no-op push caused by the null default in handleNewBooking.ts, with the same fix.

groups.defect: Office365, Lark and BaseCalendarService always use destinationCalendar[0] instead of the destination matching the creating credential, so other collective hosts' events target the wrong calendar id (and the stored reference's externalId disagrees with where the event went).
groups.rationale: All three report the same hard-coded first-destination selection repeated across several calendar services, each needing its own edit.

groups.defect: Destinations with no credentialId: Google createEvent matches only by credentialId and falls back to 'primary' instead of the destination's externalId, and EventManager's else-branch calls createEvent without destination.externalId, so the stored reference has no externalCalendarId.
groups.rationale: All describe the same broken handling of destinations without a credentialId, pointing at the Google createEvent lookup and/or the EventManager else-branch. They overlap on the same two defects.

groups.defect: The new fallback loads a credential from the DB by the stored credentialId and uses it without checking ownership or the invalid flag, in EventManager create/update and in handleCancelBooking.
groups.rationale: Same unscoped credential fallback repeated in several places; s_9518d664 explicitly calls itself the same issue as the EventManager one.
